tools.description: Freeform and organic solid modeling: B-spline curves, NURBS surfaces, organic loft with curvature control, anatomical cross-section sweeps, skin/blend surfaces, and point-cloud-driven geometry. operation.description: bspline_curve: open or closed B-spline through control points. bezier_curve: Bezier curve from poles. interpolated_curve: curve passing exactly through given points with optional tangent vectors. bspline_surface: NURBS surface from a grid of control points (u×v). ruled_surface: linear interpolation between two curves. filling_surface: G1/G2 surface patch filling a closed boundary of curves. organic_loft: loft between cross-section sketches with curvature-continuous spine;   supports variable twist and per-section scaling. organic_sweep: sweep a profile along a B-spline path with optional normal correction. skin_solid: closes a set of cross-section wires into a solid with skin surface (C2). section_profiles: generate evenly-spaced cross-section sketches along a spine curve   (useful as input for organic_loft). offset_surface: variable-thickness offset of a shell (non-uniform wall). blend_surface: G2 blend between two existing surfaces/faces. point_cloud_surface: fit a NURBS surface to a list of 3D points. cross_section_stack: build a parametric solid from a list of 2D cross-section   measurements (e.g. circumferences along an axis) — ideal for anatomical forms. hollow_cross_section_stack: build a hollow anatomical shell (e.g. a prosthetic   socket wall) in one call by lofting sections_outer and sections_inner   separately and cutting inner from outer — replaces the old offset_surface +   offset_map (face_index) approach, which cannot survive a smooth loft's single   continuous lateral face.     trit =  0 -> sin fuerza (se omite el paso)
    trit = +1 -> fuerza +force_

Options are:
- 'add' - add a sub-issue to a parent issue in a GitHub repository.
- 'remove' - remove a sub-issue from a parent issue in a GitHub repository.
- 'reprioritize' - change the order of sub-issues within a parent issue in a GitHub repository. Use either 'after_id' or 'before_id' to specify the new position.
Writes issue hierarchy. To move a sub-issue to a new parent, use `add` with `replace_parent=true`; there is no writable parent field.

replace_parent.description: When true, replaces the sub-issue's current parent issue. Use with 'add' method only.

tools.description: Flood-select connected coplanar faces from a seed face. Selects entire flat panels by expanding to neighboring faces within an angle threshold. Ideal for selecting body panels.

face_index.description: Seed face index to start selection from

angle_threshold.description: Maximum angle in degrees between adjacent faces to include (default: 15)

tools.name: blender_mesh_select_shortest_path
tools.description: Select shortest path between two mesh elements. Useful for selecting edge loops or vertex paths along the mesh surface.

mode.description: Element type for path: VERT or EDGE

tools.name: blender_mesh_get_selection
tools.description: Query current mesh selection state without modifying it. Returns indices of selected vertices, edges, or faces.

tools.name: blender_mesh_select_edge_loops
tools.description: Select complete edge loops or edge rings through a given edge. Fundamental for hard surface modeling — loops define the flow of geometry.

edge_index.description: Edge index to find the loop through

ring.description: Select edge ring instead of edge loop

tools.name: blender_shade_smooth
tools.description: Set smooth, flat, or auto-smooth shading on an object. Auto-smooth applies smooth shading while keeping edges sharper than the angle threshold as flat — essential for mechanical surfaces.

shade_type.description: Shading type: SMOOTH (all smooth), FLAT (all flat), AUTO (angle-based)

auto_smooth_angle.description: Angle threshold in degrees for auto-smooth (default: 30)

tools.name: blender_mesh_crease
tools.description: Set edge crease values for subdivision surface control. THE hard surface modeling tool — crease=1.0 keeps edges sharp through subdivision, crease=0.5 creates softer feature lines.

edge_indices.description: Edge indices to set crease on (omit to use selected_only)

selected_only.description: Apply to currently selected edges (if edge_indices not provided)

tools.name: blender_mesh_mark_sharp
tools.description: Mark or clear sharp edges. Sharp edges override auto-smooth angle for precise normal control on specific edges.

edge_indices.description: Edge indices to mark (omit to use selected_only)

clear.description: Clear sharp marking instead of setting it

selected_only.description: Apply to currently selected edges (if edge_indices not provided)

tools.name: blender_mesh_mark_seam
tools.description: Mark or clear UV seams on edges. UV seams define where the UV map is cut for unwrapping. Essential for texture mapping preparation.

edge_indices.description: Edge indices to mark (omit to use selected_only)

clear.description: Clear seam marking instead of setting it

selected_only.description: Apply to currently selected edges (if edge_indices not provided)

tools.name: blender_mesh_dissolve
tools.description: Remove vertices, edges, or faces while preserving surrounding geometry. Unlike delete, dissolve merges the surrounding geometry to fill the gap.

use_face_split.description: Split off face corners to maintain face integrity

tools.name: blender_mesh_merge
tools.description: Merge vertices together — close gaps, join geometry, remove doubles. Supports merge to center, first, last, or by distance threshold.

merge_type.description: How to merge: CENTER (average position), FIRST, LAST, or BY_DISTANCE

tools.name: blender_mesh_bridge
tools.description: Bridge two edge loops to create connecting faces — connect body panels, create tubes between openings, join separate mesh islands.

tools.name: blender_mesh_fill
tools.description: Fill boundary edges with faces — cap holes, close open geometry. Supports n-gon fill, triangle fan, and grid fill.

edge_indices.description: Edge indices forming the boundary to fill

fill_type.description: Fill method: NGON (single face), TRIANGLE_FAN, or GRID (requires even loop)

use_beauty.description: Use beauty fill for better triangulation

tools.name: blender_mesh_subdivide
tools.description: Subdivide selected edges/faces to add resolution. Add geometry where needed without subdividing the entire mesh.

edge_indices.description: Edge indices to subdivide (omit to subdivide all)

quad_corner_type.description: How to handle quad corners during subdivision

tools.name: blender_mesh_edge_slide
tools.description: Slide edges along their connected faces to fine-tune edge loop position. Non-destructive repositioning of topology.

even.description: Use even slide mode for uniform spacing

tools.name: blender_mesh_tris_to_quads
tools.description: Convert triangles to quads — clean up triangulated meshes to get cleaner quad topology. Pairs adjacent triangles based on angle and UV matching.

face_indices.description: Face indices to process (omit for all triangles)

angle_limit.description: Maximum angle between triangle normals to join (degrees)

compare_uvs.description: Only join triangles with matching UV edges

tools.name: blender_mesh_knife_project
tools.description: Project a curve or mesh outline onto a target surface to cut panel lines. The cutter object is projected along the view/normal onto the target.

target_object.description: Name of the object to cut into

cutter_object.description: Name of the curve/mesh to project as cutter

cut_through.description: Cut through entire mesh (not just front faces)

tools.name: blender_mesh_bisect
tools.description: Cut mesh with an infinite plane defined by a point and normal. Can optionally clear geometry on either side and fill the cut. Perfect for splitting vehicles into sections.

plane_point.description: Point on the cutting plane [x, y, z]

plane_normal.description: Normal direction of the cutting plane [x, y, z]

clear_inner.description: Remove geometry on the negative side of the plane

clear_outer.description: Remove geometry on the positive side of the plane

fill.description: Fill the cut plane with a face

tools.name: blender_mesh_separate_selected
tools.description: Separate selected faces into a new object — extract body panels, components, or regions into independent objects.

face_indices.description: Face indices to separate into a new object

new_name.description: Name for the new separated object (optional)

tools.name: blender_mesh_split
tools.description: Split edges or faces without separating into a new object — creates hard boundaries within the mesh by duplicating shared vertices.

indices.description: Indices of edges or faces to split

tools.name: blender_silhouette_compare
tools.description: Render object silhouette and compare against a reference image. Returns a difference score and overlay image for proportion verification.

object_name.description: Name of the object to render

tools.name: blender_measure
tools.description: Measure distances, bounding box dimensions, edge lengths, and vertex-to-vertex distances in world units.

point_a.description: First point [x, y, z] for DISTANCE mode

point_b.description: Second point [x, y, z] for DISTANCE mode

vertex_indices.description: Two vertex indices for VERTEX_DISTANCE mode

tools.name: blender_reference_image_setup
tools.description: Load a reference image as a background empty for modeling viewport overlay. Position it on a specific axis plane for tracing geometry.

image_path.description: Path to the reference image file

axis.description: Axis plane to position the image on

offset.description: Distance offset along the axis normal

size.description: Display size of the reference image

tools.name: blender_array_along_curve
tools.description: Instance objects along a curve path — rivet lines, bolt patterns, cable runs. Uses Array + Curve modifiers for parametric control.

source_object.description: Name of the object to array

curve_name.description: Name of the curve to follow

count.description: Number of instances along the curve

fit_type.description: How to distribute instances: FIXED_COUNT, FIT_LENGTH, or FIT_CURVE

apply.description: Apply modifiers immediately (makes instances real geometry)

tools.name: blender_scatter_on_surface
tools.description: Scatter objects on a mesh surface using a particle system — bolts, rivets, damage marks, vegetation. Control count, randomization, and area restriction.

target_object.description: Name of the surface object to scatter on

source_object.description: Name of the object to scatter

vertex_group.description: Vertex group to restrict scattering area (optional)

tools.name: blender_collection_instance
tools.description: Place collection instances at specific locations — efficient placement of repeated complex objects like wheel assemblies, control panels, or structural details.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection to instance

locations.description: Array of [x, y, z] positions for instances

rotations.description: Optional array of [x, y, z] rotations in degrees per instance

scales.description: Optional array of [x, y, z] scales per instance

tools.name: blender_mesh_proportional_transform
tools.description: Move, rotate, or scale vertices with proportional falloff affecting neighbors — organic shape refinement, smooth deformations, sculpt-like adjustments via MCP.

vertex_indices.description: Center vertex indices for the transform

value.description: Transform value: [x,y,z] for translate/scale, [angle_degrees, axis_x, axis_y, axis_z] for rotate

tools.name: blender_mesh_shrinkwrap
tools.description: Snap vertices to another object's surface — conform details to body panels, project geometry onto curved surfaces.

object_name.description: Name of the object whose vertices to snap

target_object.description: Name of the target surface object

vertex_indices.description: Specific vertex indices to snap (omit for all)

tools.name: blender_mesh_flatten
tools.description: Flatten selected vertices to a plane — clean up bumpy surfaces, create perfectly flat areas on body panels.

plane.description: Plane to flatten to: axis plane or BEST_FIT (PCA-derived)

tools.name: blender_sculpt_setup
tools.description: Enter sculpt mode with configuration. Supports MULTIRES (subdivision levels), DYNTOPO (dynamic topology for adaptive detail), and SIMPLE mode. Can configure symmetry axes for mirrored sculpting.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to sculpt

mode.description: Sculpting mode: MULTIRES adds subdivision levels, DYNTOPO enables dynamic topology, SIMPLE enters sculpt mode as-is

multires_levels.description: Number of multires subdivision levels to add (default: 3, only used with MULTIRES mode)

dyntopo_detail.description: Dynamic topology detail size (default: 12.0, only used with DYNTOPO mode)

symmetry_axes.description: Axes to enable sculpt symmetry on, e.g. ['X'] for bilateral symmetry

tools.name: blender_sculpt_mesh_filter
tools.description: Apply global mesh filters to a sculpt-mode object. Unlike brush strokes, mesh filters affect the entire mesh uniformly and work reliably over MCP. Useful for smoothing, sharpening detail, adding surface noise, inflating, or relaxing topology.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object (must be in sculpt mode or will be switched)

filter_type.description: Type of mesh filter to apply

iterations.description: Number of times to apply the filter (default: 1)

tools.name: blender_sculpt_mask_by_topology
tools.description: Create sculpt masks based on topology features. Masks control which parts of the mesh are affected by sculpting operations. CAVITY masks concave areas, ALL fills the entire mask, NONE clears it, RANDOM creates a random mask pattern. Optional blur smooths mask edges.

invert.description: Invert the mask after creation (default: false)

blur_iterations.description: Number of blur/smooth passes on the mask (default: 0)

tools.name: blender_sculpt_face_set_create
tools.description: Create face sets by grouping faces based on criteria. Face sets partition the mesh into regions for isolated sculpting. LINKED groups connected geometry, MATERIAL groups by material assignment, NORMAL groups by face orientation, SHARP_EDGES splits at sharp edges, UV_ISLAND groups by UV islands.

tools.name: blender_sculpt_multires_reshape
tools.description: Manage multiresolution modifier levels for sculpting. SUBDIVIDE adds a level, UNSUBDIVIDE removes the highest level, REBUILD reconstructs subdivisions, APPLY_BASE applies sculpted changes to the base mesh, DELETE_HIGHER removes levels above current, DELETE_LOWER removes levels below current.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object with a Multires modifier

action.description: Action to perform on the multires modifier

tools.name: blender_sculpt_to_retopo
tools.description: Pipeline tool: convert a high-poly sculpt to a retopologized low-poly mesh with optional displacement map baking. Creates a duplicate, applies remesh (voxel or quadriflow), auto-UV unwraps, and optionally bakes displacement from the original. Essential for game-ready asset production.

object_name.description: Name of the high-poly sculpted mesh object

target_polycount.description: Target polygon count for the retopo mesh (default: 5000)

bake_displacement.description: Bake displacement map from original to retopo mesh (default: true)

displacement_resolution.description: Resolution of the displacement map in pixels (default: 2048)

output_displacement_path.description: File path to save the baked displacement map (optional, defaults to temp file)

tools.name: blender_sculpt_extract_mask
tools.description: Extract the masked region of a sculpt as a separate mesh object. Creates a new mesh from faces above the mask threshold, optionally adding thickness via solidify. Useful for creating armor plates, panel lines, or detail pieces from sculpted forms.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object with an active sculpt mask

smooth_iterations.description: Number of smooth iterations on the extracted boundary (default: 2)

tools.name: blender_sculpt_remesh_voxel
tools.description: Apply voxel remesh to create a uniform topology. Converts the mesh to a voxel representation and back, producing evenly-spaced quads. Useful for cleaning up boolean results, imported meshes, or preparing for sculpting. Smaller voxel_size = higher detail but more polygons.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to remesh

voxel_size.description: Size of voxels in world units - smaller = more detail (default: 0.05)

fix_poles.description: Attempt to fix topology poles after remesh (default: false)

tools.name: blender_armature_create
tools.description: Create an armature from a list of bone definitions. Each bone specifies head/tail positions, optional parent, connection state, and roll angle. Use this for precise skeleton construction from known bone positions.

connected.description: Whether bone is connected to parent (head snaps to parent tail)

tools.name: blender_autorig_preset
tools.description: One-call auto-rig generator. Creates a complete bone hierarchy for common use cases: BIPED (humanoid), QUADRUPED (four-legged), VEHICLE (wheels + steering), MECHANICAL_ARM (IK chain), TURRET (rotate + elevate), WHEEL_ASSEMBLY (axle + spin), DOOR_HINGE (limited rotation), PISTON (stretch-to pair), LA

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to rig (required for auto-weighting)

auto_weight.description: Automatically parent mesh with armature deform + automatic weights (default: true)

msfs_compatible.description: Use MSFS-compatible bone naming conventions (default: false)

tools.name: blender_constraint_add
tools.description: Add a constraint to a bone or object. Supports IK, copy transforms, tracking, stretch-to, limits, floor, and child-of constraints. Specify either bone_name (for pose bone constraint) or object_name (for object constraint), plus target and type-specific settings.

armature_name.description: Name of the armature object (required for bone constraints)

bone_name.description: Name of the bone to add constraint to (for bone constraints)

object_name.description: Name of the object to add constraint to (for object constraints)

target_object.description: Name of the target object for the constraint

target_bone.description: Name of the target bone (if target is an armature)

settings.description: Constraint-specific settings as key-value pairs (e.g. chain_count for IK, axis for track_to)

tools.name: blender_constraint_preset
tools.description: Apply preset constraint setups that require multiple coordinated constraints. IK_ARM: IK chain with pole target. IK_LEG: IK with foot roll. PISTON_PAIR: two bones with mutual stretch-to. WHEEL_SPIN: rotation driver. DOOR_SWING: limit rotation constraint. TURRET_TRACK: two-axis tracking.

tools.name: blender_bone_shape_assign
tools.description: Assign a custom wireframe control shape to a bone for rig visualization. Creates (or reuses) a wire mesh shape and assigns it as the bone's custom_shape. Shapes: CIRCLE, SQUARE, CUBE, SPHERE, ARROW, DIAMOND, CROSS.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone to assign the shape to

shape.description: Shape type for the bone control widget

tools.name: blender_pose_library_save
tools.description: Save the current pose of an armature as a named pose. Stores bone transforms (location, rotation, scale) as custom properties on the armature. Optionally filter to save only specific bones.

pose_name.description: Name to save the pose under

bone_filter.description: Optional list of bone names to include (all bones if omitted)

tools.name: blender_pose_library_apply
tools.description: Apply a previously saved pose to an armature. Supports blending with the current pose via blend_factor (0=keep current, 1=full saved pose). Useful for creating animation keyframes from preset poses.

pose_name.description: Name of the saved pose to apply

blend_factor.description: Blend factor between current pose (0) and saved pose (1). Default: 1.0

tools.name: blender_rig_validate
tools.description: Validate an armature rig for export compatibility. Checks bone naming conventions, hierarchy structure, constraint setup, deform bone flags, and scale/orientation. Returns a list of issues and a compatibility score for the target format.

armature_name.description: Name of the armature object to validate

target_format.description: Target export format to validate against (default: GENERIC)

tools.name: blender_physics_rigid_body_add
tools.description: Add a rigid body physics simulation to an object. Makes it participate in physics as either an active (affected by forces) or passive (static collider) body.

object_name.description: Name of the object to add rigid body to

body_type.description: Type of rigid body: ACTIVE (dynamic, affected by forces) or PASSIVE (static collider). Default: ACTIVE

mass.description: Mass of the object in kilograms. Default: 1.0

collision_shape.description: Collision shape type. CONVEX_HULL is a good default for most objects. MESH is most accurate but slowest. Default: CONVEX_HULL

tools.name: blender_physics_rigid_body_batch
tools.description: Add rigid body physics to multiple objects at once. Optionally designate a ground/floor object as a PASSIVE collider.

object_names.description: List of object names to add rigid bodies to

body_type.description: Type of rigid body for all listed objects. Default: ACTIVE

mass.description: Mass for all objects in kilograms. Default: 1.0

ground_object.description: Optional name of an object to set as PASSIVE (ground/floor collider). This object does not need to be in object_names.

tools.name: blender_physics_simulate
tools.description: Run the physics simulation for a frame range. Optionally apply results to make the final positions permanent (freezes simulation).

apply_results.description: If true, apply the visual transform at frame_end and remove rigid bodies, making positions permanent. Default: false

tools.name: blender_physics_cloth_add
tools.description: Add cloth simulation to a mesh object. Supports material presets (silk, cotton, denim, etc.), vertex group pinning, collision objects, and wind.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to add cloth simulation to

preset.description: Material preset controlling stiffness, mass, and damping. Default: COTTON

pin_vertex_group.description: Name of a vertex group to pin (vertices in this group stay fixed in place)

collision_objects.description: Names of objects that the cloth should collide with

wind_strength.description: Strength of wind force. 0 = no wind. Default: 0.0

wind_direction.description: Wind direction as [x, y, z] vector. Default: [1, 0, 0]

tools.name: blender_physics_soft_body_add
tools.description: Add soft body simulation to a mesh object. Soft bodies deform under forces while trying to maintain their shape.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to add soft body to

goal_strength.description: How strongly the object tries to return to its original shape (0=fully soft, 1=rigid). Default: 0.7

mass.description: Mass of the soft body in kilograms. Default: 1.0

friction.description: Friction coefficient for the soft body surface. Default: 0.5

tools.name: blender_physics_fluid_quick
tools.description: Quick fluid simulation setup with a domain and flow object. Creates a Mantaflow-based liquid or gas simulation.

domain_object.description: Name of the object to use as the fluid domain (bounding box for the simulation)

flow_object.description: Name of the object to use as the fluid inflow source

fluid_type.description: Type of fluid simulation. Default: LIQUID

resolution.description: Simulation grid resolution (higher = more detailed but slower). Default: 64

tools.name: blender_annotation_add
tools.description: Add 3D annotation strokes to the scene as a grease pencil annotation layer. Useful for marking up geometry, drawing guides, or highlighting areas of interest.

points.description: Array of [x, y, z] points defining the stroke path

color.description: Stroke color as [R, G, B, A] with values 0-1. Default: [1, 0, 0, 1] (red)

layer_name.description: Name of the annotation layer to add strokes to. Created if it doesn't exist. Default: 'Annotations'

tools.name: blender_annotation_text
tools.description: Add a 3D text annotation at a specific location. Creates a font/text object that can be used as a label or callout.

location.description: Position as [x, y, z] where the text should be placed

color.description: Text color as [R, G, B, A] with values 0-1. Default: [1, 1, 1, 1] (white)

tools.name: blender_annotation_dimension
tools.description: Add a dimension line between two 3D points showing the distance measurement. Creates endpoint markers, a connecting line, and a text label with the calculated distance.

offset.description: Perpendicular offset distance for the dimension line from the measured points. Default: 0.5

units.description: Display units for the measurement. Default: METERS

label.description: Override label text. If omitted, the calculated distance with units is used.

tools.name: blender_annotation_clear
tools.description: Clear annotation layers. Can clear a specific layer by name or all annotation layers at once.

layer_name.description: Name of the annotation layer to clear. If omitted, clears ALL annotation layers.

tools.name: blender_grease_pencil_create
tools.description: Create a grease pencil object with one or more strokes. Grease pencil objects are persistent 2D/3D drawing objects in the scene.

name.description: Name for the grease pencil object. Default: 'GPencil'

points.description: Array of [x, y, z] points for this stroke

thickness.description: Line thickness for this stroke. Default: 10

strokes.description: Array of stroke definitions, each with points and optional thickness

color.description: Stroke color as [R, G, B, A] with values 0-1. Default: [0, 0, 0, 1] (black)

tools.name: blender_grease_pencil_markup
tools.description: Overlay markup annotations (arrows, circles, rectangles, text) on a rendered image. Uses Pillow if available, otherwise falls back to Blender compositor.

render_path.description: Path to the input rendered image file (PNG, JPG, etc.)

start.description: Start point [x, y] in pixel coordinates. Used by arrow and rectangle.

end.description: End point [x, y] in pixel coordinates. Used by arrow and rectangle.

center.description: Center point [x, y] in pixel coordinates. Used by circle.

radius.description: Radius in pixels. Used by circle.

position.description: Position [x, y] in pixel coordinates. Used by text.

text.description: Text content. Used by text annotation type.

color.description: Color as a CSS-style string (e.g., 'red', '#FF0000'). Default: 'red'

font_size.description: Font size for text annotations. Default: 24

annotations.description: Array of annotation objects to draw on the image

output_path.description: Path to save the annotated output image

tools.name: blender_material_inspect_graph
tools.description: Return the full shader node graph of a material as structured JSON. Lists every node (name, type, location, input values/connections, output connections) and every link (from_node, from_output, to_node, to_input).

material_name.description: Name of the material to inspect

tools.name: blender_material_node_add
tools.description: Add a shader node to a material's node tree. Supports any Blender node type (e.g. ShaderNodeTexNoise, ShaderNodeMixRGB, ShaderNodeBump, ShaderNodeMapping, ShaderNodeNormalMap, ShaderNodeValToRGB, etc.). Optionally set location and input default values.

name.description: Optional display name for the node

location.description: Node location [x, y] in the node editor

inputs.description: Object mapping input socket names to default values. Scalar inputs use a number, vector/color inputs use an array.

tools.name: blender_material_node_connect
tools.description: Connect two nodes in a material's shader graph via their socket names. Creates a link from an output socket on one node to an input socket on another.

from_output.description: Name of the output socket on the source node

to_input.description: Name of the input socket on the destination node

tools.name: blender_material_node_group_create
tools.description: Create a reusable shader node group with defined inputs and outputs. The group can later be instanced inside any material via a ShaderNodeGroup node.

default.description: Default value (number for FLOAT/VALUE, [r,g,b,a] for RGBA, [x,y,z] for VECTOR)

tools.name: blender_material_procedural_preset
tools.description: Create a complex procedural material from a named preset with one call. Builds a full shader node tree. Presets: VEHICLE_PAINT, BRUSHED_METAL, CHROME, RUBBER, CARBON_FIBER, ASPHALT, TARMAC, WORN_METAL, GLASS, PLASTIC_GLOSSY, PLASTIC_MATTE, CONCRETE, FABRIC, REFLECTIVE_TAPE, LED_DISPLAY, RUST, GOLD,

color.description: Override base color as RGBA (0-1). Optional; each preset has a sensible default.

wear_amount.description: Wear/aging intensity 0-1 (used by presets that support it, e.g. WORN_METAL, SCRATCHED_PAINT)

scale.description: Texture scale multiplier (default 1.0). Affects procedural pattern size.

tools.name: blender_material_convert_to_pbr
tools.description: Convert a material's existing node tree to a clean Principled BSDF setup. Analyzes current nodes to extract color, roughness, metallic, etc., then rebuilds as a standard PBR graph compatible with the target format.

material_name.description: Name of the material to convert

target_format.description: Target format to optimize the PBR setup for

tools.name: blender_material_preview_render
tools.description: Render a material preview on a standard shape. Creates a temporary scene with the chosen shape, assigns the material, renders it, and returns the output path.

material_name.description: Name of the material to preview

preview_shape.description: Shape to render the material on (default: SPHERE)

resolution.description: Render resolution in pixels, used for both width and height (default: 512)

tools.name: blender_measure_surface_area
tools.description: Calculate total surface area of a mesh object, with optional per-material breakdown.  Reports area in scene units squared (typically m^2).  Supports local or world-space calculation.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to measure

per_material.description: If true, return area breakdown grouped by material slot

world_space.description: If true, apply the object's world matrix so the area reflects actual scene-space size

tools.name: blender_measure_volume
tools.description: Calculate the enclosed volume of a mesh object.  Returns volume in scene units cubed (typically m^3).  Also reports whether the mesh is manifold (watertight).

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to measure

tools.name: blender_measure_clearance
tools.description: Measure the minimum, average, and maximum distance between two mesh objects.  Detects intersection (overlap) and returns the closest point pair.  Useful for collision/clearance checks.

object_a.description: Name of the first mesh object

object_b.description: Name of the second mesh object

sample_count.description: Maximum number of vertices to sample from object_a when computing distances (higher = more accurate, slower)

tools.name: blender_validate_dimensions
tools.description: Check an object's bounding-box dimensions against expected values with a configurable tolerance.  Reports per-axis pass/fail with deviations.

object_name.description: Name of the object to validate

expected.description: Expected dimensions. Provide any subset of length/width/height.

tolerance.description: Allowed absolute deviation per axis (scene units)

axis_mapping.description: Map length/width/height to scene axes.  Defaults to length=x, width=y, height=z.

tools.name: blender_calibrate_from_reference
tools.description: Scale an object uniformly so that a known real-world dimension matches along a chosen axis.  Applies transforms afterwards so scale returns to (1,1,1).

object_name.description: Name of the object to calibrate

known_dimension.description: Real-world size the object should be along the chosen axis, in target_units

dimension_axis.description: Axis to match the known dimension on

target_units.description: Unit system for known_dimension.  The value is converted to scene units (meters) before scaling.

tools.name: blender_measure_edge_angle
tools.description: Measure dihedral angles (face-to-face) at mesh edges.  Optionally filter to specific edge indices and flag edges outside a threshold range.  Angles are in degrees.

edge_indices.description: Specific edge indices to measure.  If omitted, all edges with 2+ linked faces are measured.

threshold_min.description: Minimum acceptable angle in degrees.  Edges below this are flagged.

threshold_max.description: Maximum acceptable angle in degrees.  Edges above this are flagged.

tools.name: blender_validate_mesh_quality
tools.description: Run a comprehensive mesh quality audit.  Returns an overall score (0-1), per-check pass/fail results, and a list of blocking issues that would prevent clean export.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to validate

checks.description: List of checks to run.  If omitted, all checks are executed.

tools.name: blender_collection_create
tools.description: Create a new collection. Collections organize objects into logical groups in the scene hierarchy.

parent.description: Name of parent collection to nest under (defaults to Scene Collection)

color_tag.description: Color tag for the collection in the outliner

tools.name: blender_collection_list
tools.description: List all collections in the scene with their full hierarchy, objects, visibility, and render state. Returns a nested tree structure.

tools.name: blender_collection_move
tools.description: Move one or more objects to a target collection. Can optionally remove them from their current collections.

target_collection.description: Name of the target collection to move objects into

remove_from_current.description: Remove objects from their current collections (default: true). Set false to link into multiple collections.

tools.name: blender_collection_visibility
tools.description: Toggle collection visibility, renderability, and selectability in the current view layer.

visible.description: Set viewport visibility (hide_viewport on the layer collection)

tools.description: Redo the last undone operation in Blender. Equivalent to Ctrl+Shift+Z.

tools.name: blender_save
tools.description: Save the current Blender file. The file must have been saved at least once before (has a filepath).

tools.description: Save the current Blender file to a new path. Creates parent directories if needed.

tools.name: blender_bake_pbr_batch
tools.description: Bake ALL PBR texture channels in one call. Switches to Cycles, iterates over requested channels (DIFFUSE, ROUGHNESS, METALLIC, NORMAL, AO, EMISSION, DISPLACEMENT, COMBINED), creates temp images, configures bake settings, and saves each map to disk. Returns a dict mapping channel name to output file

object_name.description: Name of the object to bake from

channels.description: Which PBR channels to bake. Default: all channels. Each channel produces a separate texture file.

use_cage.description: Use cage for ray casting (default false)

tools.name: blender_bake_highpoly_to_lowpoly
tools.description: Bake detail from a high-poly mesh onto a low-poly mesh using 'selected to active'. Ideal for transferring normals, AO, and other maps from a sculpt or subdivision model to a game-ready low-poly mesh.

lowpoly_name.description: Name of the low-poly target object (active)

highpoly_name.description: Name of the high-poly source object (selected)

output_prefix.description: Filename prefix (defaults to lowpoly object name)

tools.name: blender_bake_from_multires
tools.description: Bake maps from a Multiresolution modifier (normals or displacement). Uses Blender's multires bake mode to transfer detail from higher subdivision levels to a texture.

object_name.description: Name of the object with a Multiresolution modifier

map_type.description: Type of map to bake (default NORMALS)

output_path.description: Full file path for the output image

tools.name: blender_bake_to_vertex_colors
tools.description: Bake lighting or material information directly to vertex colors. Creates a vertex color layer, bakes to a temporary image, then transfers pixel data to per-vertex colors via UV lookup. Useful for mobile/performance rendering where texture lookups are expensive.

object_name.description: Name of the object to bake

vertex_color_name.description: Name for the vertex color layer (default 'BakedColor')

tools.name: blender_bake_curvature
tools.description: Bake a curvature map from mesh geometry. Calculates per-vertex curvature using the dot product of vertex normals vs averaged neighbor normals. Maps concave areas to dark, convex to bright (or both). Useful for edge wear, dirt accumulation, and procedural texturing masks.

object_name.description: Name of the object to calculate curvature for

output_path.description: Full file path for the output curvature map

cavity_type.description: Which curvature to capture: CONCAVE (cavities dark), CONVEX (edges bright), or BOTH (default BOTH)

tools.name: blender_bake_id_map
tools.description: Bake a color ID map where each material, object, or face set is assigned a distinct flat color. Temporarily overrides materials with emission shaders, bakes EMIT, then restores originals. Essential for texture painting workflows and Substance Painter masks.

object_name.description: Name of the object to bake ID map for

output_path.description: Full file path for the output ID map

color_mode.description: How to assign ID colors: PER_MATERIAL (one color per material slot), PER_OBJECT (one color per joined sub-object), or PER_FACE_SET (one color per face set). Default PER_MATERIAL.

tools.name: blender_geonode_create_group
tools.description: Create a new Geometry Nodes node group with typed inputs and outputs.  A Geometry input and Geometry output are always added automatically.  Returns the group name and socket layout.

name.description: Name for the new geometry node group

inputs.description: Extra input sockets to add (beyond the default Geometry input)

default.description: Default value for the socket (number, bool, [x,y,z], or string)

outputs.description: Extra output sockets to add (beyond the default Geometry output)

tools.name: blender_geonode_apply
tools.description: Apply an existing Geometry Nodes group to an object as a modifier and optionally set input values.  Returns the modifier name and current input state.

object_name.description: Name of the object to add the modifier to

node_group.description: Name of an existing GeometryNodeTree in bpy.data.node_groups

inputs.description: Mapping of input socket names to values.  Numbers, booleans, [x,y,z] vectors, and object/material names (as strings) are accepted.

tools.name: blender_geonode_scatter_instances
tools.description: One-call scatter: build a complete Geometry Nodes setup that distributes instances of one object across the surface of another.  Supports density, Poisson-disk spacing, random scale range, random rotation, and normal alignment.

target_object.description: Name of the surface object to scatter onto

instance_object.description: Name of the object to instance

density.description: Points per unit area (higher = more instances)

min_distance.description: Minimum distance between points.  If > 0, Poisson Disk distribution is used instead of random.

rotation_random.description: Random rotation range in degrees [X, Y, Z].  Each axis gets uniform random rotation from -value to +value.

align_to_normal.description: Rotate instances to align with the surface normal

tools.name: blender_geonode_array_grid
tools.description: Parametric array patterns via Geometry Nodes.  Instances an object in LINEAR, GRID_2D, RADIAL, or HEXAGONAL arrangements.  The modifier is applied to object_name.

object_name.description: Object that receives the GN modifier (typically an empty or the instance_object itself)

instance_object.description: Object to be instanced in the pattern

count_x.description: Count along primary axis (or total for LINEAR)

radial_count.description: Number of instances around the circle (RADIAL)

tools.name: blender_geonode_deform_curve
tools.description: Deform a mesh along a curve using Geometry Nodes.  The mesh is stretched or fitted along the curve length.  Useful for roads, rails, cables, and profile sweeps.

object_name.description: Name of the mesh object to deform

curve_name.description: Name of the curve object to deform along

stretch.description: If true, stretch the mesh to fill the curve length; otherwise clamp to original mesh length

tools.name: blender_geonode_extrude_profile
tools.description: Extrude a 2D profile mesh along a curve path using the Curve to Mesh node.  Creates a new object with the extruded geometry.  Great for pipes, railings, moulding, and trim.

profile_object.description: Name of the profile object (mesh or curve) to sweep along the path

curve_name.description: Name of the curve to extrude along

fill_caps.description: Fill the start and end caps of the extrusion

resolution.description: Curve resolution (segments per spline point).  Higher values produce smoother bends.

tools.name: blender_geonode_inspect
tools.description: Read the current Geometry Nodes setup on an object.  Returns the node group name, all input names/types/current values, and output names.  Useful for introspection before tweaking values with geonode_apply.

object_name.description: Name of the object to inspect

modifier_name.description: Name of a specific GN modifier.  If omitted, the first Geometry Nodes modifier found is used.

tools.name: fit_growth_curve
tools.description:
Ajusta una curva de crecimiento bacteriano (logistica o Gompertz) a
    datos reales de tiempo vs. densidad (OD600, UFC/ml, etc). Devuelve
    capacidad de carga, tasa de crecimiento, y tiempo de duplicacion o lag.

tools.name: simulate_growth
tools.description:
Simula una curva de crecimiento bacteriano (logistica o Gompertz) dados
    los parametros, sin necesidad de datos reales.

tools.name: simulate_sir
tools.description:
Simula un modelo epidemiologico SIR (Susceptibles-Infectados-
    Recuperados). beta = tasa de transmision, gamma_recovery = tasa de
    recuperacion (1/duracion infecciosa).

tools.name: simulate_seir
tools.description:
Simula un modelo epidemiologico SEIR (agrega clase Expuesto/latente).
    sigma_incubation = tasa de progresion de expuesto a infeccioso
    (1/periodo de incubacion).

tools.name: estimate_r0_from_growth_rate
tools.description:
Estima R0 a partir de la tasa de crecimiento exponencial observada al
    inicio de un brote y el tiempo de generacion, formula simplificada tipo
    SIR: R0 = 1 + r * Tg.

tools.name: simulate_viral_infection
tools.description:
Simula un modelo de infeccion viral intracelular 'target cell-limited'
    (celulas diana, celulas infectadas, virus libre). Util para dinamica de
    infeccion dentro de un huesped.

tools.name: create_section
tools.description:

    tramo de dendrita/axon.

tools.name: connect_sections
tools.description: Conecta dos secciones para formar una morfologia (ej. dendrita al soma).

tools.name: insert_hh_channels

    seccion, dandole capacidad de disparar potenciales de accion.

tools.name: insert_passive
tools.description: Inserta un canal pasivo (fuga simple) en una seccion.

tools.name: add_current_clamp
tools.description:
Agrega un electrodo de corriente (current clamp) para estimular una
    seccion e inducir potenciales de accion.

tools.name: run_simulation
tools.description:
Corre la simulacion y graba el potencial de membrana de una o mas
    secciones a lo largo del tiempo.

tools.name: get_membrane_potential
tools.description:
Devuelve la serie de tiempo del potencial de membrana grabado para una
    seccion, luego de correr 'run_simulation'.

tools.name: list_sections

tools.name: reset_model
tools.description: Borra todas las secciones, estimulos y grabaciones.

custom_equations.description: Solo si system='custom'. Ecuaciones Octave separadas por ';', usando y(1),y(2),...

tools.description: Genera un diagrama de bifurcación para un mapa iterativo 1D (x_next = f(x,r)), barriendo un rango de r y guardando los puntos del atractor tras un transitorio. tools.name: create_test
tools.description: Crea un nuevo test (banco de items) vacio identificado por test_name.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description:
Agrega (o sobrescribe) un item al banco de un test, con parametros IRT
    iniciales: a=discriminacion, b=dificultad, c=guessing (0 para 2PL).

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Lista los items de un test con sus parametros IRT actuales.

tools.name: item_information
tools.description:
Calcula la curva de informacion de Fisher de un item (formula 3PL,
    se reduce a 2PL si guessing=0) a lo largo del rango de theta.

tools.name: test_information_curve
tools.description:
Suma la informacion de todos los items del test en cada nivel de theta.
    Esta curva es la 'profundidad' real del test: donde es alta, el test mide
    con precision; donde es baja, el test es ciego a esa zona del rasgo.

tools.name: calibrate_items
tools.description:
Estima parametros IRT (a, b, y c si model='3pl') a partir de una matriz
    real de respuestas (filas=personas, columnas=items, 0/1), usando girth.
    Sobrescribe los parametros de los items existentes, en orden.

tools.name: score_respondent
tools.description:
Estima el nivel del rasgo latente (theta) de una persona via maxima
    verosimilitud, dado un patron de respuestas 0/1 a items ya calibrados.

tools.name: run_adaptive_session
tools.description:
Simula una sesion de test adaptativo (CAT): en cada paso elige, entre
    los items no usados, el que maximiza la informacion en la estimacion
    actual de theta, simula la respuesta segun 'true_theta', y reestima theta.
    Se detiene por max_items o cuando el error estandar cae bajo 'se_stop'.

tools.name: validate_structure
tools.description:
Corre un analisis factorial exploratorio (EFA) sobre datos de respuesta
    reales, para chequear si los items cargan segun los constructos que
    predice el marco teorico del test.

tools.name: reset_bank
tools.description: Borra todos los tests y items.

tools.name: sbtcvm_write_memory
tools.description: Escribe un valor decimal en una direccion de memoria. column: 'inst' o 'data'.

tools.name: sbtcvm_reset
tools.description:
Soft-reset de la CPU de la sesion (limpia registros, pilas y punteros;
    no recarga la ROM ni borra la memoria de datos ya modificada).

tools.name: insight_cvar_subscribe
tools.description:
Vigila un conjunto de cvars y reporta los cambios desde la ultima lectura.

        La primera llamada establece la linea base. Cada llamada posterior
        devuelve los cvars cuyo valor cambio y actualiza la linea base, de
        modo que dos llamadas seguidas detectan solo lo que paso entre ell

tools.name: insight_mat_validate
tools.description:
Audita el grafo de un material: nodos, conexiones y pines sueltos.

        Args:
            material_path: ruta del asset, ej "/Game/Materials/M_Test_Material".
            check_nodes: True inspecciona cada nodo (mas lento, mas preciso).

tools.name: insight_batch_execute
tools.description:
Ejecuta una lista de comandos del bridge y devuelve el resultado de cada paso.

        Args:
            commands: lista de {"command": "<nombre>", "params": {...}}.
            stop_on_error: True aborta en el primer paso fallido.
            max_result_chars: tope de caracteres del resultado embe

tools.name: insight_profile_frame
tools.description:
Captura estadisticas de frame ejecutando comandos de consola de stat.

        Args:
            commands: comandos de consola, por defecto ["stat unit", "stat fps", "stat game"].

tools.name: insight_change_track
tools.description:
Detecta assets creados o borrados desde la ultima lectura del AssetRegistry.

        La primera llamada establece la linea base. Cada llamada posterior
        devuelve los assets nuevos y los que desaparecieron.

        Args:
            path: ruta de paquete base.
            asset_class: clase

tools.name: insight_perf_measure
tools.description:
Mide el tiempo de N ejecuciones de un comando del bridge.

        Args:
            command: nombre del comando, ej "get_actors_in_level".
            params: parametros del comando.
            runs: numero de ejecuciones a promediar.
